<includeonly>{{Fanhome|url=star-wars/millenium-falcon|text=''Millennium Falcon''|nolive=1}} indicates that the first two issues of ''[[Star Wars: Millennium Falcon (magazine)|Star Wars: Millennium Falcon]]'' were shipped together, and issues 3-6 was shipped the next month, with each month afterwards including 5 issues, aside from the final shipment of 4. ==Usage==
Copy-paste the following code and replace "NUMBER" with the appropriate issue number.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>FalconDates|''NUMBER''}}

===Example===
 <nowiki>{{FalconDates|75}}</nowiki>
